REST API for the env0 infrastructure-as-code automation platform. Provides programmatic access to organizations, projects, environments, deployments, templates, modules, agents, configuration variables, credentials, RBAC, approval policies, and VCS provider mappings. Rate limited to 1,000 requests per 60 seconds. Best-effort spec derived from publicly documented surfaces; not exhaustive.
